traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md defines support for a new @supports annotation allowing multi-story requirement mapping, while maintaining backward compatibility with @story/@req and supporting mixed usage. The implementation matches this specification:
- Core functionality and format validation: valid-annotation-format parses @supports as `@supports ...`, validates story path and requirement IDs, and coexists with @story/@req in the same comments. - Deep validation: valid-req-reference (via valid-req-reference-helpers) resolves each @supports story path, loads its requirements, and validates each REQ ID, with per-story scoping and clear error messages including reqId and storyPath. - Rule integration: require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation treat @supports as satisfying both story and requirement annotation requirements, while legacy-only code paths still behave as before. - Mixed usage: tests explicitly cover comments mixing @story, @req, and @supports in the same block and across multiple stories. - Backward compatibility: numerous tests demonstrate legacy @story/@req behavior is unchanged, and additional tests ensure missing annotations without @supports remain errors. - Documentation/migration: rules and tests around prefer-supports-annotation / prefer-implements-annotation reflect the ADR decision to standardize on @supports and provide migration guidance.
All relevant unit and integration tests pass in the current run, and key implementation files carry explicit @supports traceability annotations back to this story and its REQs. Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for story 010.2 are fully implemented.
